answer: Sliding fee discount program for patient (Medical, Psychiatric, Behavioral Health, Dental, Chiropractice and Vision) and internal pharmacy services. This provides the opportunity for low-income persons to access care and pharmaceuticals at a reduced cost.

Net operating loss to organization to provide patient service program (Primary medical, OB, Psychiatric, Behavioral Health, Dental, Chiropractice and Vision), including all applicable revenue sources (net patient fees, grants, contributions and incentive programs). Includes mobile and school based operations and all applicable translation costs.

Net operating cost to provide social services to persons within the community, both patients and non-patients. This inlcudes patient advocacy, case management, social workers, food distribution and associated costs with the Parent and Infant Center. This provides those in need with clothing, diapers, formula and other items needed to care for children.
